controls.title: AI risk identification process
controls.summary: The vendor has a structured process for identifying risks specific to AI systems, including technical, ethical, legal, and reputational risk categories.
controls.validationGuidance: Look for risk identification that goes beyond technical failure modes to include misuse, bias, and societal impact.

controls.title: Stakeholder identification for AI risk analysis
controls.summary: The vendor identifies all relevant stakeholders potentially affected by an AI system's decisions or outputs, not only the direct customer.
controls.validationGuidance: Check whether end users or affected third parties (not just the paying customer) are considered in the analysis.

controls.title: Likelihood and severity risk analysis methodology
controls.summary: Identified AI risks are analyzed using a consistent methodology to estimate likelihood and severity of potential harm.
controls.validationGuidance: A documented scoring or rating method is stronger evidence than qualitative-only judgment calls.

controls.title: Risk evaluation against defined acceptance criteria
controls.summary: The organization has predefined risk acceptance criteria for AI systems and evaluates identified risks against them before deployment.
controls.validationGuidance: Criteria should be defined in advance, not decided ad hoc per project after risks are already found.

controls.title: Risk treatment plan and residual risk documentation
controls.summary: For risks that exceed acceptance criteria, the vendor documents a treatment plan and tracks residual risk after mitigation.
controls.validationGuidance: Ask specifically for an example of residual risk being formally accepted by an accountable owner, not just mitigated silently.

controls.title: Monitoring and review of AI risk over the system lifecycle
controls.summary: AI risk assessments are revisited periodically and when material changes occur (model updates, new use cases, new data sources).
controls.validationGuidance: This mirrors a common gap in other frameworks - check for an event-driven trigger, not only a fixed annual review cycle.

controls.title: Communication and consultation on AI risk with affected parties
controls.summary: The vendor has a process for communicating relevant AI risk information to customers or affected stakeholders where appropriate.
controls.validationGuidance: Look for proactive disclosure of known limitations, not only disclosure in response to an incident.
